'''Sakidopa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LoNH" /> of the [[Sakidopa system/Legends|Sakidopa system]], situated in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> A secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Saki system/Legends|Saki system]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]] of the planet [[Sakiya]]&mdash;also known as Saki&mdash;[[Colonist/Legends|settled]] Sakidopa&mdash;the name of which, meaning "Second Saki,"<ref name="LoNH" /> was shared with "dopa," the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] word for "two."<ref name="Phrasebook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> Sakidopa was established as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony to support the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] manufacturing industry that developed on Sakiya and was considered a part of the group known as the [[Sakiyan Collective]].<ref name="LoNH" />

On Sakidopa, the Sakiyans mined the exotic element [[graxitium]], which they shipped off for enrichment at a [[Unidentified Sakiyan facility|facility]] near [[the Godsheart]] [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] and ultimately used to produce repulsorlift circuitry.<ref name="LoNH" /> As with other Sakiyan colony worlds, the fate of Sakidopa in the aftermath of Hutt Space's [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> was not widely known.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sakidopa was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
